نحتفر (form VIII)
# نَحْتَفِرُ (naḥtafiru) /naħ.ta.fi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# نُحْتَفَرُ (nuḥtafaru) /nuħ.ta.fa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# نَحْتَفِرَ (naḥtafira) /naħ.ta.fi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# نُحْتَفَرَ (nuḥtafara) /nuħ.ta.fa.ra/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
